decisions.reason: 具体场景 test_adapter_failure_still_stops_real_owned_process。逐项参数：pytest.mark.parametrize('failure', [RuntimeError, asyncio.CancelledError])。可观察预期：assert process.poll() is not None；assert lifecycle['stopped'] is True；assert lifecycle['owned_pid'] == process.pid；assert 'lifecycle.json' in json.loads((tmp_path / 'manifest.json').read_text())['files']。准备脚本 adapter 关闭失败或取消时仍必须结束自己拥有的服务并封存退出记录，避免后台进程泄漏。
